meta.title: Boxing & MMA gym fit-outs — rings, cages, bags, mats | bolt-sport

assembly.eyebrow: How a gym gets built — from measurement to handover
heading: Five stages.
No surprises.

steps.title: Measurement & site survey
steps.description: We come to you. We measure clear height, column spacing, service runs and the ceiling's real load capacity. That becomes the drawing production works from — not your floor-plan PDF.

steps.title: Mats & flooring
steps.description: Thickness and hardness picked for the discipline: a different mat for wrestling and grappling than for stand-up. Cut to the room's exact dimensions, no offcuts along the walls.

steps.title: Mounts & structure
steps.description: Bag brackets, wall frames, suspensions. Every anchor point is fixed to match what's actually in the wall — concrete, block, reinforced concrete — and recorded in as-built documentation.

steps.title: Ring or cage
steps.description: Platform, structure, ropes or mesh installed. We build and level the ring on site; the cage goes together from sections sized to fit through your doors.

steps.title: Handover & documentation
steps.description: Load test on the mounts, handover protocol, product data sheets and warranties. We show you how to take apart and rebuild whatever you'll be moving yourselves.

heading: Everything is made
in Krasiejów.
production.paragraph: Welding, upholstery, cutting and finishing under one roof. We don't resell someone else's equipment — so a non-standard ring size or rope colour is a change to the drawing, not a reason to say no.

facilityTypes.eyebrow: Pick the closest match — the qualifier narrows down the rest
heading: Four kinds
of projects.

items.title: Boxing club
items.description: 5×5 or 6×6 ring, bag wall, mats across the whole training floor, mirrors and ladders. The typical first project for a club moving out of a rented room.

items.title: MMA club
items.description: 6–8 m octagon cage, 40 mm grappling mat zone, free-standing and wall-mounted bags. More than in boxing, it comes down to how easily it takes apart — clubs relocate every few years.

items.title: Sports facility & school
items.description: Equipment built for shift use and facility-manager oversight: certificates, tender documentation, foldable and stowable gear. Deferred-payment invoicing available.

items.title: Event arena
items.description: Ring or cage for fight nights, raised platform, sponsor banners, transport and on-site setup within a 24-hour window. Rental or purchase, depending on your event cycle.

details.label: Detail 01
details.title: Ropes
details.description: Steel core in a polyurethane sheath, wrapped in a cotton sleeve. It doesn't go slack after a season and doesn't graze forearm skin the way bare tarpaulin does.

details.label: Detail 02
details.title: Corner post
details.description: Structural steel post with a high-resilience foam guard in a PVC cover. The cover can be printed — club logo, sponsor, or ours.

details.label: Detail 03
details.title: Platform
details.description: Bolted frame from closed profiles, 22 mm OSB deck and shock-absorbing foam under the canvas. Takes apart — fits through a standard door.

details.label: Detail 04
details.title: Canvas
details.description: Ring canvas over foam with controlled rebound — soft enough to fall on, firm enough to work your footwork. Non-slip and washable.

faq.eyebrow: Six questions we hear before signing
heading: What you ask
before signing.

items.question: Will my ceiling take a ring and hanging bags?
items.answer: On the site visit we check the ceiling type and whatever building documentation is available. A ring spreads its load across the whole platform footprint and is rarely an issue in practice; hanging bags more often are. If the ceiling can't be trusted, we switch to free-standing structures or frames that transfer the load to load-bearing walls. We don't install by guesswork, and we don't ask the client to carry that risk.

items.question: Deferred-payment invoicing — is that possible?
items.answer: Yes. Our standard terms are a deposit plus final payment on handover. For local-government bodies, schools and municipal facilities we offer 30- or 60-day deferred terms with no deposit, based on a contract or public order.

items.question: Can you prepare tender documentation?
items.answer: Yes. We provide the scope of supply, technical data sheets, certificates and material approvals, plus a cost breakdown in whatever format the contracting authority requires. We write specifications in equivalent terms, without naming a specific product, so the procedure can't be challenged.

items.question: Our room has an odd shape and low ceilings. Can anything be done?
items.answer: Usually, yes. We manufacture in-house, so ring size, post height and frame length are a change to the drawing, not a separate order with an outside supplier. With low ceilings we move from suspended mounts to wall-mounted and free-standing structures — that usually ends up using the room better than the original plan.

items.question: How long does the whole thing actually take?
items.answer: From signing to handover, usually 4–8 weeks: 3–6 weeks of production and 1–4 days of installation. We give you a date after the measurement, not before. If you have a fixed opening or fight-night date, we'll tell you straight away whether we can make it.

items.question: Will you travel to the other end of Poland?
items.answer: Yes — we install anywhere in Poland with our own crews, no subcontractors. Travel, lodging and installation equipment are included in the quote regardless of distance from Krasiejów. Warranty service is 48 hours.
